assertions.subject: Spinal tuberculosis
assertions.quote: Early-onset paraplegia may occur due to mechanical compression by tuberculous debris, bone or disk sequestrum, tuberculomas, granulomas, or abscess in extradural, intradural, or intramedullary regions, myelitis with cord edema, meningeal inflammation, and anterior spinal artery thrombosis with cord infarction.
